topic: Water blob and fizzy tablet in space
hook: If you drop a fizzy tablet in a space water ball, the bubbles stay trapped.
title: A Fizzy Tablet Inside a Floating Water Ball
description:
In microgravity, water pulls itself into a floating, wobbling sphere. Astronauts on the ISS dropped an effervescent tablet into one, and the gas bubbles stayed inside the ball because nothing makes them rise. Part of our If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Space #ISS
